title: Audubon's Birds of America
description: John James Audubon's monumental Birds of America (1827–1838) — every species of the young nation's birds, engraved and hand-colored at life size.

items.title: Louisiana Water Thrush
items.description_narrative: A single streaked brown-and-white bird perches beneath a cluster of drooping leaves and a spray of small red berries, its bill parted as if calling out.
items.tags: songbird, streaked plumage, berries, branch, small bird, engraving

items.title: Roscoe's Yellow-throat
items.description_narrative: A small bird with a black mask and bright yellow throat perches quietly among glossy, spade-shaped leaves, its plumage nearly matching the green foliage around it.
items.tags: warbler, songbird, engraving, foliage, leaves, small bird, perched

items.title: Song Sparrow
items.description_narrative: One bird throws its head back mid-song on a berry-hung branch while a second, lower bird sits quietly among small white blossoms.
items.tags: sparrow, songbird, engraving, singing, branch, blossom, pair

items.title: Orchard Oriole
items.description_narrative: A cluster of small birds gathers around a woven, cup-shaped nest tucked into thorny, fern-like leaves. Two show bold orange-red and black plumage, while two companions are a soft olive-yellow, one clinging just beside the nest's opening.
items.tags: songbird, nest, thorny branch, orange plumage, family group, engraving

items.title: Hermit Thrush
items.description_narrative: Two soft brown thrushes perch on the same berry-hung branch, one upright near the top with its speckled breast turned outward, the other settled lower with wings drawn close. Clusters of small red fruit dangle around them against an otherwise bare page.
items.tags: thrush, songbird, berries, branch, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: 1. Columbian Water Ouzel - 2. Arctic Water Ouzel
items.description_narrative: Two plump gray birds perch on rocky ledges on either side of a rushing stream running between cliffs. It belongs to the University of Pittsburgh.
items.tags: audubon, engraving, water ouzel, dipper, mountain stream, natural history

items.title: Bird of Washington
items.description_narrative: A large dark eagle stands solidly on a rock outcrop, wings folded close, its hooked bill and pale eye turned to the side as powerful yellow talons grip the stone.
items.tags: eagle, raptor, talons, rock perch, dark plumage, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Great-footed Hawk
items.description_narrative: Two falcons face off over a fallen duck, wings raised and talons braced, one with its hooked bill streaked red. Scattered feathers and the duck's limp form lie between them on the bare rock.
items.tags: falcon, bird of prey, hunting, feathers, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Carolina Parrot
items.description_narrative: Seven parakeets crowd a tangle of bare branches and seed pods, their green bodies and golden heads splashed with orange around the face. Wings spread in every direction as the birds twist, climb, and reach for the thistle-like seed heads.
items.tags: parakeet, parrot, flock, green plumage, branches, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Black-billed Cuckoo
items.description_narrative: Two slender, long-tailed cuckoos move through an enormous white magnolia blossom, one leaning down toward the flower's center as a small insect hovers nearby among the glossy leaves.
items.tags: cuckoo, magnolia blossom, long tail, songbird, glossy leaves, hand-colored engraving

items.title: American Goldfinch
items.description_narrative: Two bright yellow-and-black goldfinches cling to a spiny thistle plant, one hanging upside-down as it picks at a spent purple bloom, feathery thistledown scattered around them.
items.tags: goldfinch, thistle, yellow and black, feeding, songbird, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Children's Warbler
items.description_narrative: Two plain olive-yellow birds cling to a slender flowering stem, one reaching up toward small yellow blossoms and one hanging with wings spread along a lower leaf. Slim seed pods dangle from the same branch.
items.tags: warbler, songbird, yellow plumage, flowering branch, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Stanley Hawk
items.description_narrative: One young hawk spreads its wings to show a bold barred pattern while a second perches nearby, and high above them a small blue bird flies past, seemingly unbothered by the hunters below.
items.tags: hawk, raptor, engraving, wing pattern, contrast, small bird, pair

items.title: Blue-green Warbler
items.description_narrative: A small blue-gray warbler perches quietly on a branch heavy with clusters of ripe red berries and broad green leaves.
items.tags: warbler, blue-gray plumage, red berries, songbird, branch, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Cuvier's Regulus
items.description_narrative: A small gray-brown bird perches quietly on a woody stem surrounded by clusters of pink-and-white blossoms, its plain coloring a soft contrast to the flowers' delicate petals. Glossy oval leaves crowd the branch on all sides.
items.tags: kinglet, songbird, blossoms, branch, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Loggerhead Shrike
items.description_narrative: Two black-and-white birds meet in a berry-laden, thorny vine, one gripping a small brown mouse in its foot. Delicate white blossoms and dark clustered fruit hang along the branch around them.
items.tags: shrike, songbird, prey, berries, thorny vine, engraving

items.title: Carbonated Warbler
items.description_narrative: Two small yellow-breasted birds with streaked black markings work opposite ends of the same leafy branch, dark cherries dangling within easy reach. Broad green leaves curl around them on a spray that loops from top to bottom of the page.
items.tags: warbler, songbird, cherries, foliage, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Swallow-tailed Hawk
items.description_narrative: Its deeply forked black-and-white tail streaming behind, a hawk banks through the air clutching a slender green snake in its talons.
items.tags: hawk, raptor, engraving, snake, flight, forked tail, dramatic

items.title: Marsh Wren
items.description_narrative: Four tiny wrens attend a woven, globe-shaped nest built into a clump of tall marsh grass, one perched on a bent stalk above and others clinging near its dark round opening.
items.tags: wren, songbird, woven nest, marsh grass, family scene, engraving

items.title: Yellow-billed Cuckoo
items.description_narrative: Two cuckoos move through broad papaw leaves and hanging fruit, one snapping its bill at a swallowtail butterfly caught mid-flight. This is plate 2 of Birds of America.
items.tags: cuckoo, butterfly, papaw, audubon, birds of america

items.title: Snow Bird
items.description_narrative: Two dark-hooded, white-bellied birds perch on a slender twig hung with small dark berries, their plain plumage set against bare branches.
items.tags: junco, songbird, engraving, berries, branch, simple, pair

items.title: Carolina Turtle Dove
items.description_narrative: Two soft brown doves lean close together on a bare branch above, while below a third feeds a fledgling at a grass nest tucked among white five-petaled blossoms. Long pointed tails and gently iridescent necks mark all three birds.
items.tags: dove, songbird, nest, blossoms, family of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Mocking Bird
items.description_narrative: Four birds converge in alarm around their nest, wings spread and bills open wide, as a large snake coils up through the flowering vine toward the eggs and fledglings below.
items.tags: songbird, nest defense, snake, flowering vine, dramatic scene, engraving

items.title: Red headed Woodpecker
items.description_narrative: Five woodpeckers in striking black, white, and crimson plumage cluster around a weathered, hollowed snag, adults feeding young that peer out from holes bored into the wood.
items.tags: woodpecker, red plumage, nest holes, tree snag, family group, engraving

items.title: White-headed Eagle
items.description_narrative: Talons sunk into a large fish, a white-headed eagle stands with wings mantled protectively over its catch on a bare rocky ledge.
items.tags: eagle, raptor, engraving, fish, talons, rocky ledge, dramatic

items.title: Golden-winged Woodpecker
items.description_narrative: Five woodpeckers cluster around a hollowed, moss-patched snag, red crescents marking their necks and black bibs across their chests. One clings upside down with wings and spotted tail spread wide, while another peers out from a hole in the wood.
items.tags: woodpecker, songbird, tree trunk, flock, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: American Redstart
items.description_narrative: A black-and-orange warbler perches above its paler olive-and-yellow mate on a flowering branch, both positioned just above a large gray paper wasp nest hanging from the same stem.
items.tags: redstart, warbler, wasp nest, flowering branch, orange and black, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Red-shouldered Hawk
items.creation_date: 1827-1838 (publication; from painting made in Louisiana c. 1826)
items.date_display: 1827-1838 (publication; from painting made in Louisiana c. 1826)
items.description_narrative: Perched on a moss- and lichen-draped branch, one hawk grips the wood tightly while a second bird below spreads its banded tail wide. Oak leaves and hanging tufts of Spanish moss fill the scene.
items.tags: hawk, raptor, engraving, branch, woodland, tail feathers, perched

items.title: Great Horned Owl
items.description_narrative: Feathered ear tufts stand alert on both of these owls, their round yellow eyes staring straight out from finely mottled brown-and-cream plumage. One grips a lichen-crusted branch above its mate, wings held close against a barred chest.
items.tags: owl, ear tufts, perched, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Passenger Pigeon
items.description_narrative: A male pigeon, breast washed in warm rust and back in blue-gray, leans down to touch bills with a female perched just below him on a lichen-spotted branch, a single withered leaf hanging nearby.
items.tags: pigeon, courtship, branch, rust plumage, lichen, engraving

items.title: White-eyed Flycatcher or Vireo
items.description_narrative: Hanging upside down beneath a spray of small pink flowers, a small olive-yellow bird reaches for an insect drifting just below a twining vine.
items.tags: vireo, songbird, engraving, flowers, insect, hanging, small bird

items.title: Rathbone Warbler
items.description_narrative: Two small yellow-green birds perch among clusters of red-and-yellow tubular blossoms, a tiny insect caught in a strand of web nearby.
items.tags: warbler, songbird, tubular flowers, yellow-green plumage, branch, engraving

items.title: Ivory-billed Woodpecker
items.description_narrative: Three woodpeckers in bold black-and-white plumage cling to a lichen-crusted, storm-broken trunk. One, crowned in bright red, braces its pale bill against the bark while the others perch above and beside it with wings partly spread.
items.tags: woodpecker, tree trunk, red crest, lichen, black and white plumage, engraving
items.credit_line: University of Pittsburgh, Audubon's Birds of America, Darlington Digital Library, Image

items.title: Red-winged Starling or Marsh Blackbird
items.description_narrative: Glossy black males flash orange shoulder patches as one takes flight over a flowering branch, while streaky brown females perch quietly below. Delicate pink blossoms dot the twigs throughout the scene.
items.tags: blackbird, songbird, engraving, blossom, branch, flight, flock

items.title: Republican or Cliff Swallow
items.description_narrative: Gourd-shaped mud nests cling in a cluster to a rock overhang, one bird perched above the openings and another tucked into an entrance beside a pale egg resting on the ledge.
items.tags: swallow, songbird, engraving, mud nest, cliff, egg, colony

items.title: Winter Hawk
items.description_narrative: A hawk lands mid-stride in tall marsh grass, wings still raised and beak open, its talons closing on a large bullfrog. Audubon captured the moment for plate 71 of Birds of America.
items.tags: hawk, bullfrog, prey, audubon, birds of america

items.title: Wood Thrush
items.description_narrative: One thrush sings with its beak wide open from a high branch while a second bends down to forage among red berries below, both framed by a wide cream mat. This is plate 73 of Birds of America.
items.tags: wood thrush, songbird, berries, audubon, birds of america

items.title: Indigo Bird
items.description_narrative: Four small birds cluster along a flowering vine, its broad green leaves dotted with small white trumpet blossoms. The males glow a deep, unbroken blue, while their companions are a plain warm brown.
items.tags: songbird, blue plumage, flowering vine, branch, engraving, small birds

items.title: Virginian Partridge
items.description_narrative: A covey of quail scatters explosively as a hawk plunges down from above, wings and tails flared in every direction across a rocky, mountain-backed clearing.
items.tags: quail, gamebird, engraving, hawk, chaos, mountains, dramatic

items.title: Belted Kingfisher
items.description_narrative: A crested blue-and-white kingfisher perches on a bare snag as another flies just overhead, while a third, its head alone visible at the frame's edge, grips a small fish in its bill above a winding river and distant hills.
items.tags: kingfisher, crest, fishing, river landscape, blue and white, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Great Carolina Wren
items.description_narrative: A slim, curved bill and a bold pale eyebrow mark this small rusty-brown bird, perched high on a spray of tubular red-and-cream flowers with its beak open in song. A second bird climbs the same stem lower down, tail cocked upward.
items.tags: wren, songbird, flowers, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Prairie Titlark
items.description_narrative: A single streaked brown-and-white bird stands atop a low mound of rocks scattered with pink wildflowers and tufts of grass.
items.tags: songbird, streaked plumage, wildflowers, rocks, small bird, engraving

items.title: Fish Hawk or Osprey
items.description_narrative: Talons locked around a still-gasping fish, this hawk holds its catch flat against the water's surface, dark wings raised high above a white, black-streaked head. Distant hills sit low on the horizon beyond the open water.
items.tags: osprey, bird of prey, fish, hunting, water, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Whip-poor-will
items.description_narrative: A mottled brown, night-hunting bird is shown from two angles among oak leaves, a pair of moths and a caterpillar sharing the branch as if part of its evening hunt.
items.tags: nightjar, songbird, engraving, moths, oak leaves, nocturnal, camouflage

items.title: Blue-Grey Fly-catcher
items.description_narrative: Two small blue-gray flycatchers perch along a drooping branch strung with slender green catkins, one above the other among scattered leaves.
items.tags: flycatcher, blue-gray plumage, catkins, songbird, branch, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Columbia Jay
items.description_narrative: Deep blue plumage runs the length of these two jays' extravagantly long tails, each bird gripping a mossy branch with a crest of feathers standing up from its head. One tips forward to peck at a leaf while the other looks back over its shoulder.
items.tags: jay, songbird, blue plumage, long tail, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Little Screech Owl
items.description_narrative: Three small owls cluster together on a pine bough hung with cones, their plumage ranging from soft gray to rich rufous. One spreads a wing wide, revealing delicate, finely barred feathers.
items.tags: owl, pine branch, pinecones, rufous plumage, family group, engraving

items.title: Purple Finch
items.description_narrative: Three finches - two in raspberry-red plumage, one a streaked brown - perch together along a branch strung with small berries.
items.tags: finch, songbird, red plumage, berries, branch, engraving

items.title: Purple Grakle or Common Crow Blackbird
items.description_narrative: Two glossy black birds with iridescent heads perch among the husks and silk of ripening corn, one gripping a bare cob in its foot.
items.tags: blackbird, songbird, corn, iridescent plumage, black plumage, engraving

items.title: White throated Sparrow
items.description_narrative: Bold black-and-white head stripes and a bright yellow patch above the eye mark two sparrows perched together on a dogwood branch in white bloom.
items.tags: sparrow, songbird, engraving, dogwood, blossom, head stripes, pair

items.title: Selby's Flycatcher
items.description_narrative: A small olive-and-yellow bird perches on a slender stem holding two deep red berries, its plumage plain against the bare sprig.
items.tags: flycatcher, songbird, engraving, berries, small bird, branch, simple composition

items.title: Baltimore Oriole
items.description_narrative: A black-and-orange oriole perches at the mouth of a long, woven hanging nest while a second glides in above with wings spread wide, and a third rests lower on the branch, all set among broad tulip-tree leaves and pale blossoms.
items.tags: oriole, hanging nest, orange and black, tulip tree, songbird, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Purple Martin
items.description_narrative: Four birds - glossy blue-black and paler gray-brown - gather around a hollowed gourd birdhouse hung from a bare branch, one peering out from its round entrance.
items.tags: martin, songbird, gourd birdhouse, blue-black plumage, family group, engraving

items.title: Solitary Flycatcher or Vireo
items.description_narrative: A plain olive-gray bird perches quietly on a leafy branch, its simple coloring blending easily into the surrounding foliage.
items.tags: vireo, songbird, engraving, branch, foliage, plain, small bird

items.title: Towhe Bunting
items.description_narrative: John James Audubon created this plate for his Birds of America series between 1827 and 1838. Two towhe buntings perch among thorny branches and flowering vines, one bird above with its tail raised and one below turning its head downward.
items.tags: audubon, towhee, bunting, songbird, engraving, aquatint, birds of america, natural history

items.title: Vigor's Warbler
items.description_narrative: A small yellow-olive bird perches low on a grass-like stem beneath a spray of purplish flowers, its plain plumage set against the slender green leaves.
items.tags: warbler, songbird, engraving, flowers, grass, small bird, simple

items.title: Worm eating Warbler
items.description_narrative: A pale warbler tilts its head up mid-song from a low twig, while a second, darker-headed bird perches above among drooping clusters of dark berries and a curling dead leaf. This is plate 34 of Birds of America.
items.tags: warbler, songbird, berries, audubon, birds of america

items.title: Ruffed Grouse
items.description_narrative: One bird fans its dark, banded tail wide while its neck ruff stands erect, two companions crouched nearby among broad leaves and scattered dark berries on the forest floor.
items.tags: grouse, gamebird, engraving, forest floor, display, tail feathers, berries

items.title: Summer Red Bird
items.description_narrative: Two brilliant red males and one soft yellow-olive female share a fruit-hung vine, dark grapes and green leaves crowding the branch around them.
items.tags: tanager, songbird, engraving, vine, grapes, red plumage, group

items.title: Traill's Flycatcher
items.description_narrative: A small olive bird perches with its bill open as if calling, balanced on a leafy vine-wrapped branch against a plain, pale background.
items.tags: flycatcher, songbird, engraving, vine, calling, branch, small bird

items.title: Barred Owl
items.description_narrative: John James Audubon's hand-colored plate shows a Barred Owl with wings raised, perched on a broken branch as it confronts a gray squirrel below. The engraving belongs to the University of Pittsburgh's collection, created sometime between 1827 and 1838.
items.tags: audubon, hand-colored engraving, owl, natural history, birds of america, wildlife

items.title: Ruby-throated Humming Bird
items.description_narrative: A cluster of hummingbirds hovers and perches around trumpet-shaped orange blossoms, their wings a blur mid-flight as they dart between the flowers on a leafy vine.
items.tags: hummingbird, songbird, engraving, flowers, vine, flight, hovering

items.title: Black & Yellow Warbler
items.description_narrative: A small yellow-breasted warbler perches on a broad, ridged leaf, its olive back and dark wing bars framed by clusters of small green acorns.
items.tags: warbler, yellow breast, acorns, leaf, songbird, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Red-tailed Hawk
items.description_narrative: John James Audubon created this hand-colored print between 1827 and 1838, held by the University of Pittsburgh. A red-tailed hawk grips a hare in its talons while a second hawk perches close behind, wings and tail feathers spread wide.
items.tags: hand-colored print, ornithological illustration, bird of prey, audubon, birds of america, 19th century, engraving

items.title: Painted Finch
items.description_narrative: Four brilliantly colored birds, patched in blue, green, and deep red, perch and feed among small green berries on a leafy branch, one gripping a pale filament in its bill.
items.tags: bunting, songbird, colorful plumage, berries, branch, engraving

items.title: Rice Bird
items.description_narrative: A black, white, and buff male sings from a seed-hung branch while, below, a duller streaked female hangs upside down to feed among the drying pods.
items.tags: songbird, engraving, branch, seed pods, feeding, pair

items.title: Le Petit Caporal
items.description_narrative: A small hawk with gray-brown streaked plumage perches upright on a broken wooden post twined with climbing ivy. Its sharp eye and alert posture suggest it has just caught sight of something below.
items.tags: hawk, bird of prey, ivy, post, streaked plumage, engraving

items.title: Tyrant Fly-catcher
items.description_narrative: Two black-and-white birds perch among heart-shaped leaves and hanging vine tendrils, one with its bill open as if snapping at a passing insect.
items.tags: flycatcher, songbird, engraving, vine, leaves, catching insect, pair

items.title: House Wren
items.description_narrative: Two small brown wrens gather nesting material at the mouth of a battered old hat wedged into a forked branch, one gripping a twig in its beak. A pale shell lies discarded just below the makeshift nest.
items.tags: wren, songbird, nest, branch, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Florida Jay
items.description_narrative: Vivid blue wings and tail set off a soft brown back on these two jays, hanging and climbing through a branch heavy with round golden fruit. One reaches up toward the fruit while the other dives beneath the leaves, wings spread flat.
items.tags: jay, songbird, blue plumage, fruit, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Autumnal Warbler
items.description_narrative: Two olive-and-buff warblers move along a berry-studded branch, one reaching up toward small green fruit while the other pauses lower on the stem amid broad serrated leaves.
items.tags: warbler, olive plumage, berries, leaves, songbird, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Broad-winged Hawk
items.description_narrative: A broad-winged hawk perches upright beside its mate, whose wings are thrown wide to reveal a boldly banded tail, both sharing a leafy, fruit-studded branch.
items.tags: hawk, banded tail, raptor, branch, fruit, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Pigeon Hawk
items.description_narrative: Two small falcons share a leafy branch, one perched upright and alert, the other below with wings spread and bill open, sharply banded tail feathers fanned beneath it.
items.tags: falcon, bird of prey, branch, banded tail, alert posture, engraving

items.title: Sea-side Finch
items.description_narrative: Two streaked sparrows perch among the pink blossoms and thorny vines of a wild rose, one turned to face its companion lower on the same tangled stem.
items.tags: sparrow, songbird, engraving, wild rose, blossom, thorns, pair

items.title: Grass Finch or Bay-winged Bunting
items.description_narrative: A streaky brown-and-white bird rests on a weathered log beneath a flowering prickly-pear cactus, pale yellow blooms opening among the flattened, spine-dotted pads. The plant's thick green paddles curve protectively around the small bird.
items.tags: sparrow, songbird, cactus, flowers, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: White-bellied Swallow
items.description_narrative: Two swallows twist through the air together, their backs a glossy blue-green and undersides pure white, a single loose feather drifting past against a pale sky.
items.tags: swallow, songbird, engraving, flight, glossy plumage, feather, pair

items.title: Cow-pen Bird
items.description_narrative: A glossy, iridescent blue-black bird faces off with a duller brown-gray companion over a mound of moss and grass, a smaller mottled bird tucked low between them. Sparse tufts of grass ring the nest-like clump.
items.tags: cowbird, songbird, moss, ground nest, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Shore Lark
items.description_narrative: A small flock gathers on low, grassy ground, several birds showing bold black facial markings and tiny raised head-tufts as they forage together.
items.tags: lark, songbird, engraving, grassland, flock, facial markings, foraging

items.title: Canada Goose
items.description_narrative: This goose arches its black neck skyward, white cheek patch bright against dark feathers, beak open as if calling. Beside it in the reeds sits a single pale egg, tall grasses and leaves crowding the nest.
items.tags: goose, waterfowl, nest, egg, reeds, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Night Heron or Qua bird
items.description_narrative: A heron stretches its neck low toward the water, fine white plumes trailing from its crown, while a younger, streak-brown companion stands watchfully nearby among lilies and tall grass, a small frog resting on the rocks.
items.tags: heron, wading bird, plumes, lilies, frog, engraving

items.title: Bonaparte's Flycatcher
items.description_narrative: A small gray-headed, yellow-bellied flycatcher perches beneath a spike of small red blossoms, its short beak angled downward.
items.tags: flycatcher, yellow belly, red blossoms, songbird, branch, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Chipping Sparrow
items.description_narrative: A small streaky sparrow with a rusty cap perches beneath a canopy of white blossoms and slender leaves, its body angled along a bare, forking branch. The white flower clusters stand out sharply against the empty page.
items.tags: sparrow, songbird, blossoms, branch, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Large billed Puffin
items.description_narrative: A puffin with a strikingly deep, brightly colored bill stands on a mossy rock. A second floats nearby with its head ducked beneath the surface, only its dark back and folded wings showing above the waves.
items.tags: puffin, seabird, colorful bill, water, rock, engraving

items.title: Scaup Duck
items.description_narrative: Two ducks rest together on a weathered log, their dark, glossy green-black heads catching the light against soft gray plumage and a pale backdrop of tall grass.
items.tags: duck, waterfowl, engraving, log, resting, glossy plumage, pair

items.title: Crested Grebe
items.description_narrative: Two grebes swim side by side, one with its bill tipped skyward and a rust-and-black ruff framing its face, the other holding a lower, watchful profile with a slender pale neck. Faint clouds and hills blur into the water's green surface.
items.tags: grebe, waterbird, swimming, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Golden Plover
items.description_narrative: Speckled gold-and-black plumage covers all three of these plovers, one banking overhead in flight while the other two stride across bare, rocky ground. Distant hills and water fade into a pale horizon.
items.tags: plover, shorebird, flight, group of birds, hand-colored engraving, natural history illustration

items.title: Brown Titlark
items.description_narrative: Two streaked brown birds face each other atop a mossy mound, one calling with its beak open toward a small insect hovering above, a pale mushroom growing at their feet.
items.tags: titlark, streaked plumage, mossy mound, insect, songbird, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Crested Titmouse
items.description_narrative: Two crested, gray-and-white birds work a laden pine branch, one tugging at a needle cluster above while the other hangs below among dangling cones. Long green needles fan out in every direction around them.
items.tags: titmouse, songbird, pine cones, branch, pair of birds, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Cedar Bird
items.description_narrative: Two sleek, crested birds in warm tan plumage perch among feathery cedar sprigs, their wings and tails tipped in crisp black, gray, and yellow. A black mask sweeps back from each eye like a bandit's stripe.
items.tags: waxwing, songbird, cedar branch, pair of birds, crest, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Chuck-will's Widow
items.description_narrative: A banded red, black, and yellow snake winds along a branch strung with red berries as one bird swoops down with wings thrown wide and tail fanned. A second bird sits below, its enormous mouth gaping open beneath whisker-like bristles.
items.tags: nightjar, snake, branch, flight, wide gape, hand-colored engraving

items.title: Swamp Sparrow
items.description_narrative: A single streaked sparrow perches on a flowering shrub branch, one white blossom open just beside it among broad green leaves.
